description: This addon enables Spell Absorption for Breton NPCs. If you experience any Bretons "glowing blue" with this file installed, you have a mod with an incorrectly made cloak spell. Do not report this as a bug with Aetherius.
This plugin integrates the racial passives from Aetherius into Apprentice. If you would like to use Apprentice with another race mod, untick this file.

Apprentice has traits designed to work with other Simonrim mods, such as Blade and Blunt, Pilgrim, and Gourmet. Untick this file to remove these traits. Effected traits include: Drunkard, Faithful, Faithless, Milkdrinker, and Rugged.

This plugin changes Guardian Spirit so that it summons a spectral sabre cat instead of a spectral bear. For users who like cats.
